notes: REPLAY FIXED: online matches now save a replay at the end of every round (before, only offline matches did, so the Replay tab said you hadn't played). Quitting mid-match or closing the game also keeps the replay, and it's still there after a restart

BOTS THAT LEARN: bots learn from every gunfight - which tactics win on each map, the range real players fight at, where players hang out and where bots keep dying - and get smarter and more human the more they play. It carries over to every next game

MORE HUMAN BOTS: real reaction times, aim that settles instead of snapping, short bursts at range, they stop to check corners, look around, peek from cover and have a harder time hitting you while you're on the move
RECOIL: assault rifles kick 35% more, SMGs 30% more and LMGs 80% more, and every automatic climbs harder the longer you hold the trigger (LMGs most), with a sideways pull

SMARTER BOTS: they remember where they last saw you and push there, hear gunshots (suppressors keep you quiet), call out your position to teammates, flank, turn on you the moment you shoot them, back off to heal when hurt, throw grenades at you behind cover, pre-aim corners and reload when it's safe
BOTS: new ELITE skill, better aim and headshots at every skill, and the default bots are now Veteran (Hardened on the hard setting)
DAMAGE RANGE: every gun has its own damage range, tuned by class (SMGs 14-22 m, assault rifles 30-60 m, LMGs 44-58 m, marksman 60-70 m, snipers never drop, shotguns 9-14 m, pistols 12-26 m)
LOADOUT: new DAMAGE RANGE graph shows damage from 0 to 120 m and chest shots to kill at 10, 30, 60 and 100 m; compare guns before you pick (green/red line)
GUN BALANCE: every gun re-tuned around shots to kill. Assault rifles and LMGs: 4 chest shots. SMGs: 5 chest shots up close (Bulwark 4, Wasp 6) and much weaker far away
PISTOLS: Service 9 now needs 5 chest shots, Revolver 2 (3 to the stomach) and no one-shot headshots, Deadeye 3, Stinger 7. Shorter range and less accurate from the hip
ATTACHMENTS: Hollow Point (+6%) and Long Barrel (+4%) add less damage, so parts can no longer turn a 4-shot gun into a 3-shot gun
Chest shots do 10% extra (was 15%); marksman rifles take 3 body shots
PERKS ONLINE: every perk now works against real players, not just bots
SHADOW: hides you from enemy UAVs (other players' too); bots still take longer to lock on
TACTICAL MASK and stuns: a stun grenade now blinds real players who are looking at it (it only hit bots before)
BLAST VEST: now also cuts damage from other players' grenades and rockets
DEAD SILENCE: fixed, it now turns on for other players as soon as you pick it
SCAVENGER: kills (bots or players) now really top up a magazine of reserve ammo
